quests.title: Herbalist's Forage

dialogue.t: Oh yes, the commission I posted. Have you already collected ten Sweet Flowers?
Let me have a look at what you brought. Hmm... Yes, these will do just fine.
These are for you. Thanks for your help.
Let's just hope those kids stay out of trouble from now on.

quests.description: Liyue Harbor’s Herbalist Gui needs 10 Sweet Flowers.
